#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
#define pb push_back
#define ull unsigned long long
#define mp make_pair
const int maxn=5005;
const ll inf=1e9+7;

inline int read() {
    int X=0,w=0; char ch=0;
    while(!isdigit(ch)) {w|=ch=='-'; ch=getchar();}
    while(isdigit(ch)) {X=(X<<3)+(X<<1)+(ch^48); ch=getchar();}
    return w?-X:X;
}
struct edge {
    int from, to, cap, flow, cost;
    edge(int a,int b,int c,int d,int e): from(a), to(b), cap(c), flow(d), cost(e) {}
};

ll n,m;
int a[maxn];
int startPoint,endPoint;

struct MCMF {
    int n, m;
    vector<edge> e;
    vector<int> g[maxn];
    int inq[maxn], d[maxn], p[maxn], a[maxn];

    void init(int n_) {
        n=n_;
        for(int i=0; i<=n; i++) g[i].clear();
        e.clear();
    }
    void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
        e.emplace_back(from, to, cap, 0, cost);
        e.emplace_back(to, from, 0, 0, -cost);
        m=e.size();
        g[from].push_back(m-2);
        g[to].push_back(m-1);
    }
    bool bellman(int s, int t, int& flow, int& cost) {
        for(int i=0; i<=t; i++) d[i]=inf, inq[i]=0;
        d[s]=0; inq[s]=1; p[s]=0; a[s]=INT_MAX;
        queue<int> Q; Q.push(s);
        while(!Q.empty()) {
            int u=Q.front(); Q.pop(); inq[u]=0;
            for(auto i : g[u]) {
                auto& ee=e[i];
                if(ee.cap>ee.flow && d[ee.to]>d[u]+ee.cost) {
                    d[ee.to]=d[u]+ee.cost;
                    p[ee.to]=i;
                    a[ee.to]=min(a[u], ee.cap - ee.flow);
                    if(!inq[ee.to]) {
                        Q.push(ee.to);
                        inq[ee.to]=1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if(d[t]==inf) return false;
        flow+=a[t];
        cost+=d[t]*a[t];
        for(int u=t; u!=s; u=e[p[u]].from) {
            e[p[u]].flow+=a[t];
            e[p[u]^1].flow-=a[t];
        }
        return true;
    }
    int minCost(int s, int t) {
        int flow=0, cost=0;
        while(bellman(s,t,flow,cost));
        return cost;
    }
} solver;

int main() {
    int k,c,d;
    n=read(); m=read(); k=read(); c=read(); d=read();
    for(int i=1; i<=k; i++) a[i]=read();

    startPoint=0; endPoint=n*100+1;

    solver.init(endPoint+1);
    for(int i=1; i<=k; i++) {
        solver.add_edge(startPoint, 1+(a[i]-1)*100, 1, 0);
    }
    for(int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
        for(int j=1; j<100; j++) {
            int p=(i-1)*100;
            solver.add_edge(p+j, p+j+1, inf, c);
        }
    }
    for(int i=1; i<=100; i++) solver.add_edge(i, endPoint, inf, 0);

    for(int _=0; _<m; _++) {
        int x=read(), y=read();
        for(int i=1; i<100; i++) {
            int p=(x-1)*100+i;
            int pp=(y-1)*100+i+1;
            for(int j=1; j<=50; j++) {
                solver.add_edge(p, pp, 1, d*(j*j-(j-1)*(j-1))+c);
            }
        }
        for(int i=1; i<100; i++) {
            int p=(y-1)*100+i;

            for(int j=1; j<=50; j++) {
                solver.add_edge(p, pp, 1, d*(j*j-(j-1)*(j-1))+c);
